activationRule: An outcome becomes an assumed prerequisite only after its chapter, exercises and reader checks pass production review. Current Chapters 1-2 on astra-rewrite do not meet this contract.

chapters.title: What does it mean to compute?
chapters.exitCheck: Identify input and output; find an ambiguous instruction; explain why the material can change while the rule stays the same.

chapters.title: Symbols, information and representations
chapters.exitCheck: Recognize a sequence versus a set; expose an ambiguous encoding; supply a decoding key.

chapters.title: Algorithms, decisions and remembered state
chapters.exitCheck: Complete a trace; test a boundary case; explain why an instruction must terminate.

chapters.title: Your first small Python programs
chapters.exitCheck: Predict output before running; repair an index error; write a three-case test with supplied answers.

chapters.title: Cities, roads, graphs and paths
chapters.exitCheck: Reject a backwards road; identify repeated vertices; compare path and cycle without requiring a named hard problem.

chapters.title: Search, counting and growing work
chapters.exitCheck: Count a three-card case; find a checker bug; explain a small proof in words before notation.

chapters.title: Atoms, molecules and different kinds of bonds
chapters.exitCheck: Identify what each line style means; explain why base-pair marks must not look like backbone bonds.

chapters.title: Solutions, amounts, temperature and change
chapters.exitCheck: Distinguish rate from equilibrium; identify missing units; interpret a pH scale without an unsupported binding calculation.

chapters.title: Cells, chromosomes, genes and genomes
chapters.exitCheck: Distinguish gene, chromosome and genome; explain why not every cell has a nucleus.

chapters.title: From a nucleotide to a DNA strand
chapters.exitCheck: Distinguish base from nucleotide; locate the backbone; identify what a flattened drawing omits.

chapters.title: Direction, pairing and reverse complement
chapters.exitCheck: Compute AGTC and ATAT partners; reject a wrong orientation; explain why a string test does not predict binding.

chapters.title: Chance, encounters and repeated trials
chapters.exitCheck: Compute 0.19; contrast sampling with and without replacement; identify when the model is unjustified.

chapters.title: From DNA to RNA and proteins
chapters.exitCheck: Distinguish copying sequence from controlling a process; recognize that some RNAs are not translated.

chapters.title: Enzymes and DNA replication in six frames
chapters.exitCheck: Locate the growing end; repair a reversed arrow; track parental versus newly synthesized strands.

chapters.title: What a laboratory operation actually does
chapters.exitCheck: Match instruments to purpose; spot a unit error; explain why an unlabeled tube invalidates interpretation.

chapters.title: Hybridization as molecular recognition
chapters.exitCheck: Separate compatibility, occupancy and reaction speed; identify unsupported numerical predictions.

chapters.title: Cutting and joining strands
chapters.exitCheck: Predict fragments; reject incompatible orientation; distinguish association from covalent joining.

chapters.title: Copying selected DNA with PCR
chapters.exitCheck: Identify primer direction; calculate two cycles; explain why real yield need not double.

chapters.title: Separating molecules and retaining candidates
chapters.exitCheck: Read a schematic gel; distinguish amount from length; explain what a blurry band cannot establish.

chapters.title: Detecting and reading a result
chapters.exitCheck: Explain synthesizer versus sequencer; reject an overconfident negative result; propose a control.

chapters.title: Hamiltonian paths: a visual mini-course
chapters.exitCheck: Recognition, route checking, implementation and reasoning ladder; fully work one valid and two invalid routes.

chapters.title: Adleman's idea: encode a graph in DNA
chapters.exitCheck: Spot encoding ambiguity; trace one joined candidate; explain that a correct code does not guarantee physical generation.

chapters.title: Generate, filter and read the candidates
chapters.exitCheck: Keep a repeated-vertex counterexample until coverage; explain absent candidates versus missed detection.

chapters.title: What the experiment proved, and what it did not
chapters.exitCheck: Find a missing completeness premise; audit exponential material demand; state the bounded historical conclusion.

chapters.title: Languages, machines and computational models
chapters.exitCheck: Trace acceptance; explain nondeterminism versus randomness; mark theorem assumptions and idealized unlimited storage.

chapters.title: Strand, sticker and paired-strand models
chapters.exitCheck: Recognize a model operation; trace a program; reject a theorem transferred between variants.

chapters.title: Splicing and rewriting strings
chapters.exitCheck: Apply a rule; identify an illegal cut; distinguish formal closure from laboratory feasibility.

chapters.title: Reaction networks and changing amounts
chapters.exitCheck: Compute two updates; check conservation; distinguish one random path from an average.

chapters.title: Strand displacement in slow motion
chapters.exitCheck: Track conserved strands; correct an orientation mistake; identify omitted side reactions.

chapters.title: Digital and analog molecular circuits
chapters.exitCheck: Check all inputs; identify signal depletion; explain why correct isolated gates need not compose reliably.

chapters.title: Local assembly, tiles and DNA origami
chapters.exitCheck: Find a forbidden attachment; distinguish shape from algorithm; state the physical scale boundary.

chapters.title: Genes, regulation, development and evolution
chapters.exitCheck: Identify regulatory control versus sequence transfer; distinguish adaptation, mutation and development.

chapters.title: DNA storage, codes and recovery
chapters.exitCheck: Recover a toy message; measure overhead; distinguish storage from active molecular computation.

chapters.title: Many numbers at once: vectors, matrices and DNA data
chapters.exitCheck: Check dimensions; compute a two-row result; explain the two meanings of DNA computation.

chapters.title: Resources, energy, reliability and design tools
chapters.exitCheck: Reconcile units; design a control; distinguish software tests from physical validation.

chapters.title: A measured frontier and the bridge to Evolutor
chapters.exitCheck: Explain a mechanism, implement its checker, critique evidence and complete the Book II readiness tasks.
